label: It is impossible that there be no mover that moves…, from It is impossible that there be no first…
meaning: The absolute prima via conclusion entails the relative one for the same relations: if a first mover moved in no respect cannot be lacking, a mover unmoved in every respect relevant to its moving cannot be lacking either, for any relevance relation. The statement-level counterpart of the model-quantified fact AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-ABSOLUTE-CONCLUSION-ENTAILS-RELATIVE; registers the strength order between the two conclusions (#151, #1017).
